title: Just Launched our Living-World AI RPG
author: PlojOW
selftext:
It's a text-based AI RPG where the world and everything in it is human written. Its been in development for two years, finally seeing it out in the world for anyone to play is an amazing feeling.

It's still just an Alpha so I'd love to hear what people think of where it is currently. Text-Based is not everyones cup of tea but for those who are into it, I want to make it as enjoyable as possible.

For anyone interested, you can give it a go here: [https://infinityfiction.ai/](https://infinityfiction.ai/)

Please do let me know what you think!

comments.author: s_a_m_12344
comments.body: I'd rethink the tiers, I signed in, checked them, signed out, I would not buy that. Maybe check how aidungeon does it

replies.author: PlojOW
replies.body: Hey, well firstly thanks for checking it out either way. What part about the tiers puts you off? Our goal is to give subscription unlimited playtime but sadly right now thats not really viable. We also do have the first hour of gameplay free for anyone that just wants to check it out.

comments.body: Yeah I'm not gonna sign up to test.

comments.author: joeban1
comments.body:
12 hours of gameplay for $12.

Bro thinks hes giving more value than any subscription game on the market 🤣

comments.author: ItsAlwaysTerminal
comments.body: This is craaaaazy. This is basically a fancy wrapper for a couple different things it looks like, text responses via an LLM and a imagen from another. It looks intellectually lazy like youve offloaded any real game dev work to completely be on the shoulders of the AI. I mean, this is taking AI game dev way too serious where its all AI and zero game dev and those prices are wild.

replies.author: PlojOW
replies.body:
Hey, Totally fair reaction from the outside, a lot of AI RPG projects are basically just wrappers around an LLM.   
  
Whilst we are of course using AI here, what we’re trying to build is pretty different. This has been two years of multiple developers & writers getting it to the place is now. The things we are able to achieve with this engine are far from what you will find anywhere else, a consistent world that's the same each playthrough, systems which stop you from gaining whatever power you want and human written story and lore you can interact with etc. It's not for everyone, but I've been very happy to see players really enjoying what we have built so far.

comments.author: monsterfurby
comments.body:
My new minimum standard for text-based GenAI RPG frontends like this is the following:

Do you use proper name generation or does the LLM come up with names?

Because, when there are dozens of actual name generator APIs out there, getting Elaras tossed at you like there's a buy one get one free event at the orphanage is one of the clearest indicators of devs not understanding that just making a chatbot is not enough.

So... how do names work?

replies.author: PlojOW
replies.body: Hey! Names are not generated, everything inside the game world has been pre written by our team. If you start a playthrough or I do, we start in the same town with the same people ect - you get to interact with them however you want but as a baseline all locations, people, lore has been written by us. (So you wont be finding a bunch of Elaras here 😄 ).
